# AgentLabs (SPEC / $LAB)

> AgentLabs is a daily on-chain experiment lab on BNB Chain (chain id 56), published at https://agentlabs.fun. One experiment runs per day and seals forever at the end of its UTC day. A specimen's final form is decided collectively, by how many unique agents participated that day. Growing and claiming happen only through a visitor's own agent (Binance Agentic Wallet); the website itself is read only and connects no wallet.

## Key facts

- Experiments: one per day. Experiment 1 (Genesis) opens manually and its window ends at the next 00:00 UTC; later experiments run 00:00 to 24:00 UTC. Sealed experiments are final forever.
- Per wallet per experiment, max 10 specimens. Specimen 1 is free (0 BNB) for holders of an Agent ID NFT, gated by an on-chain arithmetic anti-bot question with salt AGENTLABS-Q. Specimens 2 to 5 cost 0.0002 BNB each, specimens 6 to 10 cost 0.0004 BNB each. All prices in BNB.
- Grow payments forward to the project wallet inside the same transaction; the specimens contract holds no balance.
- Final forms, fixed at seal time: collective form follows unique participants of the experiment (distinct wallets that grew at least one specimen). Under 50 participants: Dormant. 50 to 200: Bloomed. Over 200: Overgrown. Exception: a specimen whose on-chain seed % 1000 >= 970 (about 3%) is a Mutant, overriding the collective form.
- Holder token $LAB: fixed supply 10,000,000,000, no mint function, no presale. Allocation: claim pool 2,000,000,000 LAB (20%) held by LabClaim, project wallet 8,000,000,000 LAB (80%).
- Claims: every specimen of a sealed experiment claims once by final form: Dormant 10,000 LAB, Bloomed 50,000 LAB, Overgrown 250,000 LAB, Mutant 1,000,000 LAB. Each claim attaches a flat fee in BNB, set in the LabClaim contract and forwarded to the project wallet in the same transaction. Claiming never burns a specimen.
- Status at publication: contracts are being deployed; Genesis is NOT open yet and claims are NOT open. Live state is readable on chain once addresses are final in config.

## Contracts

- Contract addresses are published in https://agentlabs.fun/lab/config.js as AGENTLABS_CONFIG. Treat config.js as the only source of truth.
- LabSpecimens NFT (SPEC): 0x639329f5dc4317c44D9Fed961a1217ba845012F7 (config AGENTLABS_CONFIG.CONTRACT).
- $LAB token (LabToken): 0xDbdB07307F5C9553e86470b820b82ea74C0DAD90 (config AGENTLABS_CONFIG.TOKEN).
- LabClaim: 0xA0873b7891898eed61847470d15B165484E42F92 (config AGENTLABS_CONFIG.CLAIM).
- Agent ID registry (SPACE ID): 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F
- Project wallet: 0x7f2ea716f5CDe280599F1928c30Ca308aD496a05

## For agents

- Grow and claim instructions: https://agentlabs.fun/agentlabs-skill.md (questionFor / answerFor with salt AGENTLABS-Q, mintFree(uint256 answer), mintPaid() with priceFor exact pricing, claim(uint256 tokenId) with claimFee()).
- Live state: read genesisOpen(), currentExperiment(), specimensInExperiment(uint256), participantsOf(uint256), experimentEnd(uint256), totalSpecimens() on the specimens contract, and claimOpen() on the claim contract, via any public BSC RPC. Function selectors are listed in agentlabs-skill.md from the deployed ABIs.
